Title: Management and telemetry remain a technology-neutral contract
SecurityClaim: The architecture standardizes a management and telemetry contract while leaving internal sensors, firmware and diagnostics as implementation choices.
Applicability: Defines the observable boundary for optical-engine and platform management integration.
Limitation: The paper does not prescribe whether any management value is persistent, where it is stored, or which NVM technology is used.
OpenQuestion: Which management values must survive power loss, module replacement or controller reset, and who owns them?
Audience: AI System Architects;Photonics/CPO Teams;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Extends the secure-storage abstraction from a memory macro into a governed platform-management boundary.
TitleZH: 管理與遙測維持技術中立的介面契約
SecurityClaimZH: 此架構將管理與遙測介面標準化，同時把內部感測器、韌體與診斷機制保留為實作選擇。
ApplicabilityZH: 定義光學引擎與平台管理整合時可被觀測的系統邊界。
LimitationZH: 論文沒有規定哪些管理資料必須持久保存、儲存位置或採用何種 NVM 技術。
OpenQuestionZH: 哪些管理資料必須跨越斷電、模組更換或控制器重置而保留，且由誰負責？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把安全儲存抽象從記憶體巨集延伸到受治理的平台管理邊界。
EvidenceBoundary: The source establishes the interface contract, not a persistent-memory implementation.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 來源建立的是介面契約，而非持久記憶體實作。

Title: Optical diagnostics span multiple fault domains
SecurityClaim: Diagnostics span optical power, laser bias/temperature, wavelength, BER/FEC and link history across multiple fault domains.
Applicability: Defines the minimum observability needed to isolate OE, fiber, ODF, ELS and endpoint failures.
Limitation: A diagnostic signal set does not establish local retention, write rate, record size or an embedded-MTP logging requirement.
OpenQuestion: Which events need a local last-gasp capsule, and which should stream to BMC, host or fleet storage?
Audience: AI System Architects;Photonics/CPO Teams;RAS Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Frames operational evidence as a separate layer from immutable trust and bounded configuration state.
TitleZH: 光學診斷涵蓋多個故障域
SecurityClaimZH: 診斷範圍涵蓋光功率、雷射偏壓與溫度、波長、BER/FEC，以及跨多個故障域的鏈路歷史。
ApplicabilityZH: 定義隔離 OE、光纖、ODF、ELS 與端點故障所需的最低可觀測性。
LimitationZH: 診斷訊號集合不等於本地持久保存，也沒有建立寫入頻率、紀錄大小或嵌入式 MTP 日誌需求。
OpenQuestionZH: 哪些事件需要本地最後狀態紀錄，哪些應串流至 BMC、主機或艦隊端儲存？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把營運證據與不可變信任及有限次更新的設定狀態清楚分層。
EvidenceBoundary: The source requires observability but does not select an event-retention medium.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 來源要求可觀測性，但沒有指定事件保存媒介。

Title: Firmware lifecycle and photonic security remain open specifications
SecurityClaim: Signed firmware updates, version reporting and rollback are lifecycle topics; authentication, tamper detection and credential provisioning remain incomplete.
Applicability: Establishes the security and lifecycle work needed for managed photonic components.
Limitation: The architecture explicitly defers the secure-update path, key provisioning, tamper response and rollback semantics; it does not name OTP, MTP or a root-of-trust implementation.
OpenQuestion: What immutable trust anchor, mutable anti-rollback state and update-recovery model will the target component use?
Audience: AI System Architects;Product Security;Firmware Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Creates a direct bridge from secure-storage primitives to firmware integrity, anti-rollback and credential lifecycle.
TitleZH: 韌體生命週期與光子安全仍待規格化
SecurityClaimZH: 簽署韌體更新、版本回報與回復機制屬於生命週期議題；身分驗證、篡改偵測與憑證佈建仍未完成規格化。
ApplicabilityZH: 建立受管理光子元件所需的安全與生命週期工作範圍。
LimitationZH: 此架構明確把安全更新路徑、金鑰佈建、篡改回應與回復語意留待後續處理，也沒有指定 OTP、MTP 或信任根實作。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標元件將採用何種不可變信任錨、可更新的防回復狀態與更新復原模型？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把安全儲存原語直接連結到韌體完整性、防回復與憑證生命週期。
EvidenceBoundary: The source identifies unfinished security requirements; it does not endorse a storage technology.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 來源指出尚未完成的安全需求，但沒有背書任何儲存技術。

Title: Ring-resonator drift creates a calibration problem
SecurityClaim: Ring-resonator wavelength can drift about 80 pm/K and requires thermal control.
Applicability: Supports the need for factory characterization and a controlled runtime calibration loop in ring-based optical engines.
Limitation: Thermal drift establishes a control need, not continuous NVM writes, a specific calibration algorithm, or an MTP endurance target.
OpenQuestion: Which calibration terms must persist across cold start, and how often can a qualified profile change?
Audience: Photonics/CPO Teams;Analog/Mixed-Signal Teams;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Provides the strongest PDF-grounded path from photonic physics to a bounded persistent calibration hypothesis.
TitleZH: 環形諧振器漂移形成校準問題
SecurityClaimZH: 環形諧振器的波長可能約以 80 pm/K 漂移，因此需要熱控制。
ApplicabilityZH: 支持環形光學引擎需要出廠特性量測與受控的執行期校準迴路。
LimitationZH: 熱漂移只建立控制需求，不代表需要持續寫入 NVM，也沒有指定校準演算法或 MTP 耐久度目標。
OpenQuestionZH: 哪些校準參數必須跨越冷啟動保留，且合格設定檔可多常變更？
OIPRelevanceZH: 提供從光子物理連結到有限次持久校準假設的最直接 PDF 證據。
EvidenceBoundary: The source establishes drift and thermal control only; persistence is a downstream design decision.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 來源只建立漂移與熱控制需求；是否持久化是後續設計決策。

Title: OCP RAS exposes a managed operational interface
SecurityClaim: OCP RAS API endpoints expose discovery, configuration, reporting, action and event queues.
Applicability: Defines how AI-platform health and fault information can reach management software.
Limitation: The API defines behavior and data exchange, not local log persistence, write endurance or the underlying storage medium.
OpenQuestion: Which RAS records are configuration, bounded event capsules or high-rate streams, and what is the retention owner for each?
Audience: AI System Architects;RAS Teams;Platform Management;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Gives Copilot and SharePoint a source-backed management contract without inventing an embedded-NVM requirement.
TitleZH: OCP RAS 提供受管理的營運介面
SecurityClaimZH: OCP RAS API 端點提供探索、設定、回報、動作與事件佇列能力。
ApplicabilityZH: 定義 AI 平台的健康與故障資訊如何送達管理軟體。
LimitationZH: 此 API 定義行為與資料交換，不規定本地日誌持久性、寫入耐久度或底層儲存媒介。
OpenQuestionZH: 哪些 RAS 資料屬於設定、有限事件摘要或高頻串流，各自的保存責任歸誰？
OIPRelevanceZH: 為 Copilot 與 SharePoint 提供有來源依據的管理契約，同時不虛構嵌入式 NVM 需求。
EvidenceBoundary: The source specifies the RAS interface; storage placement remains outside its scope.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 來源規範 RAS 介面；儲存配置不在其範圍內。

Title: CMIS manages diagnostics and firmware without choosing NVM
SecurityClaim: CMIS supports diagnostics, interval statistics, firmware-revision reporting and module management; it does not prescribe the storage technology.
Applicability: Applies to managed optical modules and optical-engine control surfaces.
Limitation: CMIS register behavior and statistics do not prove that a module uses OTP, MTP, EEPROM or local persistent logging.
OpenQuestion: Which CMIS values are factory constants, field-updatable profiles, volatile counters or externally retained evidence?
Audience: Photonics/CPO Teams;Firmware Teams;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Separates a standard management surface from the internal secure-storage implementation that may support it.
TitleZH: CMIS 管理診斷與韌體，但不選定 NVM
SecurityClaimZH: CMIS 支援診斷、區間統計、韌體版本回報與模組管理，但不規定儲存技術。
ApplicabilityZH: 適用於受管理的光學模組與光學引擎控制介面。
LimitationZH: CMIS 暫存器行為與統計功能不能證明模組採用 OTP、MTP、EEPROM 或本地持久日誌。
OpenQuestionZH: 哪些 CMIS 值屬於出廠常數、現場可更新設定、揮發性計數器或外部保存證據？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把標準管理介面與其內部可能採用的安全儲存實作分離。
EvidenceBoundary: CMIS establishes functions and registers, not the technology or location of persistence.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: CMIS 建立功能與暫存器，但不決定持久化技術或位置。

Title: SPDM requires stable device identity but leaves provisioning open
SecurityClaim: SPDM hardware identity remains constant for a device instance, while key generation and provisioning mechanisms are outside the specification.
Applicability: Provides the identity and attestation contract for managed AI devices and components.
Limitation: Identity constancy does not identify whether keys are fused, PUF-derived, provisioned externally or protected by another secure element.
OpenQuestion: What threat model, provisioning authority, revocation path and recovery behavior apply to the target identity?
Audience: AI System Architects;Product Security;Platform Management;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Anchors the identity requirement while preserving an open choice between fused and reconstructed roots.
TitleZH: SPDM 要求穩定裝置身分，但保留佈建方式
SecurityClaimZH: SPDM 的硬體身分在同一裝置實例中保持不變，而金鑰產生與佈建機制不在規格範圍內。
ApplicabilityZH: 為受管理的 AI 裝置與元件提供身分及證明契約。
LimitationZH: 身分不變性無法判定金鑰是熔絲儲存、由 PUF 產生、外部佈建或由其他安全元件保護。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標身分適用何種威脅模型、佈建權限、撤銷路徑與復原行為？
OIPRelevanceZH: 建立身分需求，同時保留熔絲式與重建式信任根之間的選擇。
EvidenceBoundary: SPDM specifies identity behavior but leaves key generation, storage and provisioning outside scope.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: SPDM 規範身分行為，但把金鑰產生、儲存與佈建留在規格範圍外。

Title: CXL lifecycle features combine firmware and repair state
SecurityClaim: CXL 3.2 adds online firmware activation, post-package repair enhancements, monitoring and security functions.
Applicability: Shows that interconnect-attached AI and memory devices need coordinated firmware, repair and security lifecycle state.
Limitation: The announcement identifies capabilities but does not prescribe the storage technology, data model, write count or attestation policy.
OpenQuestion: How will post-package repair and firmware activation update measured state without breaking attestation coherence?
Audience: AI System Architects;Memory Subsystem Teams;Firmware Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Connects secure storage to legitimate lifecycle changes that must remain coherent with platform measurements.
TitleZH: CXL 生命週期功能結合韌體與修復狀態
SecurityClaimZH: CXL 3.2 新增線上韌體啟用、封裝後修復強化、監控與安全功能。
ApplicabilityZH: 顯示連接於互連架構的 AI 與記憶體裝置需要協調韌體、修復與安全生命週期狀態。
LimitationZH: 公告指出能力，但沒有規定儲存技術、資料模型、寫入次數或證明政策。
OpenQuestionZH: 封裝後修復與韌體啟用要如何更新量測狀態，同時維持證明一致性？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把安全儲存連結到必須與平台量測保持一致的合法生命週期變更。
EvidenceBoundary: The source establishes lifecycle features, not an OTP or MTP implementation.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 來源建立生命週期功能，但不是 OTP 或 MTP 實作。

Title: H100 demonstrates an on-die trust and attestation path
SecurityClaim: NVIDIA H100 uses an on-die root of trust, secure and measured boot, SPDM and attestation.
Applicability: Demonstrates that accelerator security roots and attestation are deployed product functions, not only architecture concepts.
Limitation: The public case does not disclose the exact NVM technology, key-generation method, invasive-attack resistance or applicability to other products.
OpenQuestion: Which immutable and mutable security states are required for the target accelerator, and how are they provisioned and revoked?
Audience: AI System Architects;Product Security;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Provides a shipped-system anchor for identity, secure boot, anti-rollback and attestation discussions.
TitleZH: H100 展示晶粒內信任與證明路徑
SecurityClaimZH: NVIDIA H100 採用晶粒內信任根、安全與量測開機、SPDM 及證明機制。
ApplicabilityZH: 證明加速器安全信任根與證明機制是已部署的產品功能，而不只是架構概念。
LimitationZH: 公開案例沒有揭露確切 NVM 技術、金鑰產生方式、侵入式攻擊抵抗力，也不能直接套用到其他產品。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標加速器需要哪些不可變與可更新安全狀態，且如何佈建與撤銷？
OIPRelevanceZH: 為身分、安全開機、防回復與證明討論提供已出貨系統案例。
SourceLocator: Hardware security for NVIDIA H100 GPUs
EvidenceBoundary: The product behavior is first-party evidence; its internal root storage is not disclosed here.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 產品行為屬於第一方證據，但此來源未揭露內部信任根的儲存方式。

Title: GPU row remapping persists as bounded repair state
SecurityClaim: GPU row remapping is persistent for device life and can support up to 512 remappings on the cited product family.
Applicability: Demonstrates a bounded, lifecycle-long repair-state workload in production accelerators.
Limitation: The 512-remap limit is product-family-specific and does not reveal the physical storage technology, atomic update mechanism or security policy.
OpenQuestion: What repair count, granularity, retention and failure-recovery guarantees are required on the target accelerator?
Audience: AI System Architects;Memory Repair Teams;RAS Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Shows why repair state needs bounded mutability, recovery and lifecycle governance rather than a generic fuse assumption.
TitleZH: GPU 列重映射形成有限的持久修復狀態
SecurityClaimZH: GPU 列重映射可在裝置生命週期內持久保留，且引用的產品系列最高可支援 512 次重映射。
ApplicabilityZH: 證明量產加速器中存在次數有限、跨越裝置生命週期的修復狀態工作負載。
LimitationZH: 512 次重映射是特定產品系列的限制，沒有揭露實體儲存技術、原子更新機制或安全政策。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標加速器需要多少修復次數、何種粒度、保存年限與失敗復原保證？
OIPRelevanceZH: 說明修復狀態需要有限次可更新性、復原與生命週期治理，而不能只以一般熔絲假設處理。
EvidenceBoundary: The cited product proves persistent repair behavior, not a universal implementation or endurance number.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 引用產品證明持久修復行為，但不代表通用實作或耐久度數字。

Title: Fuse-programmed HBM repair can change attestation measurements
SecurityClaim: Fuse-programmed HBM channel repair can alter physical measurements verified during attestation.
Applicability: Demonstrates that legitimate persistent repair can affect the measured identity of an accelerator platform.
Limitation: The advisory is product- and driver-specific; it does not establish a universal fuse type, repair capacity or attestation design.
OpenQuestion: How will authorized repair transitions be signed, measured and reconciled with attestation policy?
Audience: AI System Architects;Memory Repair Teams;Product Security;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Makes attestation coherence a first-class secure-storage requirement for lifecycle repair state.
TitleZH: 熔絲編程的 HBM 修復可能改變證明量測
SecurityClaimZH: 以熔絲編程的 HBM 通道修復可能改變證明流程所驗證的實體量測。
ApplicabilityZH: 證明合法的持久修復可能影響加速器平台的量測身分。
LimitationZH: 此公告僅適用特定產品與驅動程式，沒有建立通用熔絲類型、修復容量或證明設計。
OpenQuestionZH: 授權的修復狀態轉換要如何簽署、量測並與證明政策保持一致？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把證明一致性提升為生命週期修復狀態的第一級安全儲存需求。
EvidenceBoundary: The case proves a fuse-programmed repair interaction; it does not generalize the physical fuse implementation.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 案例證明熔絲編程修復與證明之間的互動，但不能推廣到所有實體熔絲實作。

Title: A fusebox can hold repair data with very few programming sessions
SecurityClaim: A fusebox stores memory-repair information and may allow only a very limited number of programming sessions.
Applicability: Provides a concrete DFT workflow for persistent SRAM-repair information.
Limitation: The workflow is vendor-specific; session count, fuse technology, field-repair support and capacity depend on the implementation.
OpenQuestion: Does the target require factory-only repair, bounded field repair, or both, and how many atomic update sessions are needed?
Audience: DFT Teams;Memory Repair Teams;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Shows that repair-state capacity and write-session topology must be defined before choosing OTP or managed NVM.
TitleZH: Fusebox 可保存修復資料，但編程次數可能極少
SecurityClaimZH: Fusebox 儲存記憶體修復資訊，且可能只允許非常有限的編程次數。
ApplicabilityZH: 提供持久 SRAM 修復資訊的具體 DFT 工作流程。
LimitationZH: 此工作流程為供應商特定實作；編程次數、熔絲技術、現場修復支援與容量皆取決於具體設計。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標需要僅出廠修復、有限次現場修復，或兩者都需要？又需要多少次原子更新？
OIPRelevanceZH: 說明選擇 OTP 或受管理 NVM 前，必須先定義修復資料容量與寫入次數模型。
EvidenceBoundary: The source documents a workflow, not a universal repair-memory architecture.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 來源記錄的是工作流程，而非通用修復記憶體架構。

Title: PMIC boot truth can be loaded from OTP
SecurityClaim: PF8100/PF8200 loads device boot configuration from an OTP fuse bank into mirror and functional registers.
Applicability: Demonstrates an immutable PMIC startup baseline that is copied into volatile control state at boot.
Limitation: This PMIC family does not establish that every AI power controller needs OTP, runtime recalibration or a high-rate persistent log.
OpenQuestion: Which startup rails, sequencing limits and fail-safe values must be immutable on the target PMIC?
Audience: Power Management Teams;AI System Architects;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Provides a shipped example of OTP baseline plus volatile runtime state at a power-control boundary.
TitleZH: PMIC 開機基準可由 OTP 載入
SecurityClaimZH: PF8100/PF8200 會把裝置開機設定從 OTP fuse bank 載入鏡像與功能暫存器。
ApplicabilityZH: 證明 PMIC 可在開機時把不可變啟動基準複製到揮發性控制狀態。
LimitationZH: 此 PMIC 系列不能證明所有 AI 電源控制器都需要 OTP、執行期重新校準或高頻持久日誌。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標 PMIC 的哪些啟動電源軌、時序限制與失效安全值必須不可變？
OIPRelevanceZH: 提供電源控制邊界採用 OTP 基準加揮發性執行狀態的已出貨案例。
EvidenceBoundary: The use of OTP is demonstrated for this component family; it is not a universal PMIC requirement.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 此元件系列證明了 OTP 的使用，但不代表所有 PMIC 都有相同要求。

Title: EEPROM black-box logging exposes endurance and power-fail limits
SecurityClaim: ADP1055 EEPROM black-box logging is bounded by temperature-dependent record limits and requires power hold-up for reliable final writes.
Applicability: Demonstrates the workload analysis required before placing fault evidence in embedded rewritable NVM.
Limitation: The record limits and hold-up behavior are specific to this device and cannot be generalized to Logic MTP, every PMIC or arbitrary event rates.
OpenQuestion: What event rate, temperature profile, record size and hold-up energy define the target black-box workload?
Audience: Power Management Teams;RAS Teams;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Turns telemetry persistence into a bounded workload question instead of an unqualified MTP claim.
TitleZH: EEPROM 黑盒日誌揭示耐久度與斷電限制
SecurityClaimZH: ADP1055 的 EEPROM 黑盒日誌受溫度相關的記錄次數限制，且可靠完成最後寫入需要電源維持時間。
ApplicabilityZH: 證明把故障證據放入可重寫嵌入式 NVM 前，必須先完成工作負載分析。
LimitationZH: 記錄限制與電源維持行為只適用此裝置，不能直接推廣到 Logic MTP、所有 PMIC 或任意事件頻率。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標黑盒工作負載的事件頻率、溫度曲線、紀錄大小與電源維持能量為何？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把遙測持久化轉化為有界工作負載問題，而不是未經限定的 MTP 宣稱。
EvidenceBoundary: The cited device demonstrates bounded EEPROM logging; it does not prove universal embedded-log fitness.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 引用裝置證明有界 EEPROM 日誌，但不能證明嵌入式日誌普遍適用。

Title: UCIe MTP means Management Transport Protocol
SecurityClaim: UCIe 2.0 adds manageability and DFx lifecycle features; its MTP acronym means Management Transport Protocol, not multiple-time-programmable memory.
Applicability: Prevents acronym collision when mapping chiplet manageability functions to persistent-state opportunities.
Limitation: Manageability and DFx lifecycle functions do not themselves require multiple-time-programmable memory.
OpenQuestion: Which UCIe management or DFx state, if any, must survive reset or power loss in the target implementation?
Audience: Chiplet Architects;DFx Teams;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Protects the evidence ledger from treating a protocol acronym as a memory requirement.
TitleZH: UCIe 的 MTP 指 Management Transport Protocol
SecurityClaimZH: UCIe 2.0 新增可管理性與 DFx 生命週期功能；其中 MTP 是 Management Transport Protocol，而非多次可程式化記憶體。
ApplicabilityZH: 避免把晶粒互連管理功能映射到持久狀態機會時發生縮寫混淆。
LimitationZH: 可管理性與 DFx 生命週期功能本身不代表需要多次可程式化記憶體。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標實作中有哪些 UCIe 管理或 DFx 狀態必須跨越重置或斷電保留？
OIPRelevanceZH: 防止證據帳本把通訊協定縮寫誤當成記憶體需求。
EvidenceBoundary: This is an acronym and lifecycle clarification, not evidence for MTP memory deployment.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 這是縮寫與生命週期釐清，不是部署 MTP 記憶體的證據。

Title: OTP vendors position immutable storage across several workloads
SecurityClaim: Synopsys positions OTP for configuration, trimming, calibration, keys, code and repair across a broad process range.
Applicability: Provides a public capability envelope for immutable and rare-write state.
Limitation: A product overview is not independent certification; exact node, capacity, PPA, temperature, security and qualification claims must be checked per macro.
OpenQuestion: Which released macro and node satisfy the target capacity, program supply, retention, qualification and threat model?
Audience: NVM IP Teams;SoC Architects;Product Security;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Defines commodity OTP use cases while keeping secure-storage assurance and node readiness as separate evidence gates.
TitleZH: OTP 供應商將不可變儲存定位於多種工作負載
SecurityClaimZH: Synopsys 將 OTP 定位於多種製程中的設定、微調、校準、金鑰、程式碼與修復用途。
ApplicabilityZH: 提供不可變與極少次寫入狀態的公開能力範圍。
LimitationZH: 產品概覽不等於獨立認證；製程節點、容量、PPA、溫度、安全性與資格宣告都必須逐一針對巨集確認。
OpenQuestionZH: 哪一個已發布巨集與節點能符合目標容量、編程供電、保存、資格與威脅模型？
OIPRelevanceZH: 定義一般 OTP 使用案例，同時把安全儲存確證與節點成熟度維持為獨立證據關卡。
EvidenceBoundary: This is a vendor-stated envelope and must not be presented as independent assurance.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 這是供應商宣告的能力範圍，不得描述為獨立確證。

Title: MTP endurance is a product envelope, not a universal category
SecurityClaim: eMemory NeoMTP is one MTP class with a vendor-stated 1K-cycle envelope; MTP is not a universal endurance category.
Applicability: Demonstrates why MTP selection must begin with a bounded update workload rather than a generic cycle assumption.
Limitation: The 1K-cycle figure applies to the cited vendor class and does not characterize every MTP macro, node, temperature or retention target.
OpenQuestion: What guaranteed cycle count, retention temperature, atomicity and error-management behavior does the target macro provide?
Audience: NVM IP Teams;SoC Architects;RAS Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Prevents the presentation from treating a single MTP endurance number as an industry-wide truth.
TitleZH: MTP 耐久度是產品能力範圍，不是通用類別
SecurityClaimZH: eMemory NeoMTP 是一種 MTP 類別，供應商宣告其耐久度範圍為 1K 次；MTP 並不是具有統一耐久度的通用類別。
ApplicabilityZH: 說明 MTP 選型必須從有界更新工作負載出發，而不是套用一般循環次數假設。
LimitationZH: 1K 次僅適用引用的供應商類別，不能代表所有 MTP 巨集、節點、溫度或保存目標。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標巨集可保證多少次寫入、何種保存溫度、原子性與錯誤管理行為？
OIPRelevanceZH: 避免簡報把單一 MTP 耐久度數字描述成全產業通則。
EvidenceBoundary: The cycle envelope is vendor-stated and product-specific, not independently generalized.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 循環次數範圍是供應商宣告且產品特定，不能未經獨立證據加以泛化。

Title: Immutable AI identity and lifecycle locks are plausible OTP or PUF-root opportunities
SecurityClaim: AI accelerator identity, immutable fail-safe defaults and lifecycle locks are plausible OTP/PUF-root opportunities.
Applicability: Applies when a target AI device requires small, immutable trust and lifecycle state at silicon boundary.
Limitation: Requires target threat model, provisioning design and node qualification.
OpenQuestion: Should the target root be fused, PUF-derived or held by another secure element, and what evidence closes that choice?
Audience: AI System Architects;Product Security;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Extends the Secure Storage abstraction to AI identity without claiming that PUF is universally superior to fused state.
TitleZH: 不可變 AI 身分與生命週期鎖是可能的 OTP 或 PUF 根機會
SecurityClaimZH: AI 加速器身分、不可變失效安全預設值與生命週期鎖，是可能的 OTP 或 PUF 根應用機會。
ApplicabilityZH: 適用於目標 AI 裝置需要少量、不可變的晶片邊界信任與生命週期狀態時。
LimitationZH: 需要目標威脅模型、佈建設計與製程節點資格證據。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標信任根應採熔絲、PUF 重建或由其他安全元件保存？需要哪些證據才能完成選擇？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把安全儲存抽象延伸到 AI 身分，同時不宣稱 PUF 普遍優於熔絲狀態。
EvidenceBoundary: This placement is an architecture hypothesis synthesized from adjacent requirements and proof cases.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 此配置是由相鄰需求與案例綜合推導的架構假設。

Title: Repair, calibration and rollback state are bounded-mutable opportunities
SecurityClaim: Bounded repair, calibration, configuration and rollback state are plausible MTP or managed-NVM opportunities.
Applicability: Applies when state must change after manufacture but has a bounded event count and explicit recovery semantics.
Limitation: Requires write cadence, atomicity, retention temperature and ownership definition.
OpenQuestion: How many updates, how many bytes and what power-fail recovery guarantee define each target workload?
Audience: AI System Architects;NVM IP Teams;RAS Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Defines the mutable layer that complements an immutable root and keeps live control loops volatile.
TitleZH: 修復、校準與回復狀態是有限次可更新的機會
SecurityClaimZH: 次數有限的修復、校準、設定與回復狀態，是可能的 MTP 或受管理 NVM 應用機會。
ApplicabilityZH: 適用於狀態需在製造後變更，但事件次數有限且具有明確復原語意的情境。
LimitationZH: 需要定義寫入頻率、原子性、保存溫度與資料責任歸屬。
OpenQuestionZH: 每個目標工作負載需要多少次更新、多少位元組，以及何種斷電復原保證？
OIPRelevanceZH: 定義與不可變信任根互補的可更新層，並讓即時控制迴路維持揮發性。
EvidenceBoundary: This is a selection hypothesis; every workload requires quantified endurance, retention and recovery evidence.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 這是選型假設；每個工作負載都需要量化的耐久度、保存與復原證據。

Title: High-rate telemetry should not default to embedded MTP
SecurityClaim: High-rate telemetry should not default to embedded MTP; use buffering, event reduction and external storage unless a bounded workload proves otherwise.
Applicability: Applies to optical telemetry, CPER/RAS events, PMIC black-box records and other potentially high-write operational evidence.
Limitation: Validate event rate, record size, power-fail behavior and service retention.
OpenQuestion: Can event reduction and last-gasp capture bound the local write workload, or should all evidence remain external?
Audience: AI System Architects;RAS Teams;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Prevents the site and presentation from turning a telemetry requirement into an unsupported MTP volume claim.
TitleZH: 高頻遙測不應預設採用嵌入式 MTP
SecurityClaimZH: 高頻遙測不應預設使用嵌入式 MTP；除非有界工作負載能證明其適用性，否則應採緩衝、事件縮減與外部儲存。
ApplicabilityZH: 適用於光學遙測、CPER/RAS 事件、PMIC 黑盒紀錄與其他可能高寫入量的營運證據。
LimitationZH: 需要驗證事件頻率、紀錄大小、斷電行為與維修保存需求。
OpenQuestionZH: 事件縮減與最後狀態擷取能否把本地寫入量限制在可控範圍，或所有證據都應保留於外部？
OIPRelevanceZH: 避免網站與簡報把遙測需求轉化成未經支持的 MTP 容量宣稱。
EvidenceBoundary: This is a conservative validation rule, not a source-mandated architecture.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 這是保守的驗證規則，不是來源強制的架構。

Title: Synopsys publicly lists a 40nm 2.5V-device-class MTP
SecurityClaim: Synopsys publicly lists a TSMC 40nm LP MTP EEPROM in the 2.5V process-I/O gate-oxide class, and its advanced-node MTP datasheet positions the family from 65nm to 40nm.
Applicability: Provides a public anchor for logic-compatible floating-gate MTP at a lower process-I/O device class than representative 3.3V or 5V offerings.
Limitation: The component listing does not prove market exclusivity, current commercial terms, or availability outside the cited process and macro release.
OpenQuestion: Which released macro, foundry option and qualification envelope are available for the target program?
Audience: NVM IP Teams;SoC Architects;Technology Strategy;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Defines a public MTP portability anchor without turning one product listing into a market-wide exclusivity claim.
TitleZH: Synopsys 公開列有 40nm 2.5V device-class MTP
SecurityClaimZH: Synopsys 公開列有 TSMC 40nm LP、2.5V process-I/O gate-oxide class 的 MTP EEPROM，其先進節點 MTP datasheet 將產品家族定位於 65nm 到 40nm。
ApplicabilityZH: 提供 logic-compatible floating-gate MTP 在低於代表性 3.3V 或 5V 方案之 process-I/O device class 的公開錨點。
LimitationZH: 此 component listing 不能證明市場唯一性、目前商務條件，或引用製程與 macro release 之外的供應狀態。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標專案可取得哪一個已發布 macro、foundry option 與 qualification envelope？
OIPRelevanceZH: 定義公開的 MTP portability 錨點，同時不把單一產品 listing 擴大成市場排他性主張。
SourceLocator: TSMC 40nm LP 2.5V MTP component page and advanced-node MTP datasheet
EvidenceBoundary: Verified public offering; exclusivity and commercial availability remain outside the public proof boundary.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 可確認公開產品；市場唯一性與商業供應狀態不在公開證據邊界內。

Title: Representative zero-mask floating-gate MTP uses 3.3V or 5V devices
SecurityClaim: eMemory states that NeoMTP reuses 3.3V or 5V I/O devices with no additional masks; its published retention envelopes differ between the 3.3V and 5V gate-oxide device classes.
Applicability: Shows how a zero-mask floating-gate MTP inherits available process-device options and why retention must be evaluated at the exact macro, oxide class and temperature.
Limitation: This is one public product family. Retention also depends on the full dielectric system, defects, cycling stress and temperature, not oxide thickness alone.
OpenQuestion: What retention, cycling and temperature evidence applies to the exact target macro and process option?
Audience: NVM IP Teams;Reliability Teams;SoC Architects;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Frames oxide availability as a process-portability constraint while preserving product-specific retention evidence.
TitleZH: 代表性 zero-mask floating-gate MTP 採用 3.3V 或 5V devices
SecurityClaimZH: eMemory 表示 NeoMTP 重用 3.3V 或 5V I/O devices 且不增加 masks；其公開 retention envelope 也依 3.3V 與 5V gate-oxide device class 而不同。
ApplicabilityZH: 說明 zero-mask floating-gate MTP 如何承接既有 process-device options，以及 retention 為何必須依確切 macro、oxide class 與溫度評估。
LimitationZH: 這只代表一個公開產品家族。Retention 還取決於完整 dielectric system、defects、cycling stress 與溫度，不是只由 oxide thickness 決定。
OpenQuestionZH: 確切目標 macro 與 process option 適用哪些 retention、cycling 與溫度證據？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把 oxide availability 定位為 process portability constraint，同時保留產品特定的 retention 證據邊界。
EvidenceBoundary: This representative vendor example cannot support the claim that every non-Synopsys MTP requires 3.3V or 5V devices.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 此代表性供應商案例不能支持所有非 Synopsys MTP 都需要 3.3V 或 5V devices 的說法。

Title: A published 28nm eFlash implementation adds memory-specific process modules
SecurityClaim: A published 28nm split-gate eFlash implementation combines a 1.8V logic-device platform with flash-specific dielectric, high-voltage devices, a triple-gate-oxide flow and additional masks.
Applicability: Demonstrates how dedicated eFlash process modules can coexist with a low-voltage logic baseline without eliminating high-field program and erase requirements.
Limitation: The mask count and device stack are implementation-specific. Commercial adoption depends on mask cost, process-development burden, yield learning and qualification rather than an absolute physical node limit.
OpenQuestion: What process adders, voltage devices, reliability qualification and cost apply to the target eFlash platform?
Audience: Process Integration;NVM IP Teams;SoC Architects;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Separates the low-voltage logic baseline from the process and high-voltage mechanisms that enable rewritable embedded flash.
TitleZH: 公開 28nm eFlash 實例加入 memory-specific process modules
SecurityClaimZH: 公開的 28nm split-gate eFlash 實例，將 1.8V logic-device platform 與 flash-specific dielectric、high-voltage devices、triple-gate-oxide flow 及額外 masks 整合。
ApplicabilityZH: 說明 dedicated eFlash process modules 如何與低電壓 logic baseline 共存，但不會消除 program 與 erase 的高電場需求。
LimitationZH: Mask 數量與 device stack 屬於特定實作。商業採用取決於 mask cost、process-development burden、yield learning 與 qualification，而不是絕對物理節點限制。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標 eFlash platform 需要哪些 process adders、voltage devices、reliability qualification 與成本？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把低電壓 logic baseline 與實現可重寫 embedded flash 的製程及高電壓機制分開。
EvidenceBoundary: The paper is a measured implementation example, not a universal process recipe. The owner-provided industry note that SST ESF3 adds more than 20 masks, constraining adoption while programs extend ESF2, remains a project-level market observation for internal validation.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 該論文是實測 implementation example，不是通用 process recipe。內容擁有者提供的業內觀察指出 SST ESF3 增加 20+ 張光罩、採用受限而專案延伸 ESF2；此資訊仍需在公司內部以專案層級驗證。

Title: Public foundry portfolios shift rewritable eNVM toward MRAM and RRAM below 28nm
SecurityClaim: Across reviewed leading-foundry public portfolios, rewritable embedded NVM below 28nm increasingly shifts from charge-storage eFlash toward eMRAM and eRRAM, with different maturity at each node.
Applicability: Provides a roadmap direction for N5-class and newer SoCs that need mutable local state but cannot assume mature embedded flash.
Limitation: Production, qualification, measured silicon and roadmap status are different. The trend does not exclude 22nm-compatible eFlash, FeRAM, FeFET, PCM, OTP, external NVM or heterogeneous integration.
OpenQuestion: Which technology and maturity level are actually available at the target node, foundry, temperature and workload?
Audience: Technology Strategy;NVM IP Teams;SoC Architects;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Reframes the advanced-node question from forcing MTP or eFlash scaling to choosing a qualified state architecture and technology path.
TitleZH: 公開 foundry portfolio 在 28nm 以下轉向 MRAM 與 RRAM
SecurityClaimZH: 在本次審閱的主流 foundry 公開 portfolio 中，28nm 以下的可重寫 embedded NVM 明顯由 charge-storage eFlash 轉向 eMRAM 與 eRRAM，但各節點成熟度不同。
ApplicabilityZH: 為需要本地可更新狀態、但不能假設 mature embedded flash 的 N5-class 與更先進 SoC 提供 roadmap direction。
LimitationZH: Production、qualification、measured silicon 與 roadmap 狀態不同。此趨勢不排除 22nm-compatible eFlash、FeRAM、FeFET、PCM、OTP、external NVM 或 heterogeneous integration。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標 node、foundry、temperature 與 workload 實際可取得哪種技術與 maturity level？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把先進節點問題從強迫 MTP 或 eFlash scaling，改為選擇合格的 state architecture 與 technology path。
EvidenceBoundary: Directionally convergent, commercially uneven; foundry node names and maturity labels are not directly interchangeable.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 方向趨同、商業成熟度不一；不同 foundry 的 node 名稱與 maturity label 不能直接互換。

Title: Synopsys documents direct core-supply read for TSMC N5 XHF OTP
SecurityClaim: Synopsys states that its TSMC N5 XHF OTP supports direct reading from core supply, attributes minimal read stress and unlimited reads to this feature, and uses a separate high-voltage charge pump for programming.
Applicability: Creates a public advanced-node example where mission-mode OTP reads can be architected separately from the controlled programming domain.
Limitation: This evidence is specific to the cited TSMC N5 XHF OTP. It does not prove the feature for MTP, N5A, N4P, N3P, N2 or every advanced-node OTP product.
OpenQuestion: Which exact macro release, wrapper domain, clock, reset and partial-power states carry the documented read behavior?
Audience: SoC Architects;Low-Power Teams;Product Security;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Defines a read-domain abstraction opportunity for advanced-node OTP without misrepresenting it as MTP or one-supply programming.
TitleZH: Synopsys 公開 TSMC N5 XHF OTP 的 core-supply 直接讀取
SecurityClaimZH: Synopsys 表示其 TSMC N5 XHF OTP 支援由 core supply 直接讀取，並將此功能連結到 minimal read stress 與 unlimited reads；programming 則使用獨立 high-voltage charge pump。
ApplicabilityZH: 提供公開的先進節點案例，使 mission-mode OTP read 可與受控 programming domain 分開設計。
LimitationZH: 此證據僅適用引用的 TSMC N5 XHF OTP，不能證明 MTP、N5A、N4P、N3P、N2 或所有先進節點 OTP 產品都具備相同行為。
OpenQuestionZH: 哪一個 exact macro release、wrapper domain、clock、reset 與 partial-power state 支援公開的 read behavior？
OIPRelevanceZH: 為先進節點 OTP 定義 read-domain abstraction opportunity，同時避免誤述為 MTP 或單電源 programming。
SourceLocator: XHF OTP NVM IP Datasheet, TSMC N5 direct-read and programming descriptions
EvidenceBoundary: The datasheet supports core-supply read and a programming charge pump. The public engineering note that PGM still uses the I/O supply as the charge-pump base voltage is owner-provided and is not attributed to the datasheet.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: Datasheet 支持 core-supply read 與 programming charge pump；PGM 仍以 I/O 電源作為 charge pump 基礎電壓的公開工程註記由內容擁有者提供，不歸因於該 datasheet。

Title: Direct core-supply read may simplify early AI-SoC state availability
AttackClass: Unsafe boot state;Unauthorized interface enable;Power-sequence dependency
SecurityClaim: When the exact macro and power intent permit it, core-domain OTP reads may expose repair maps, lifecycle policy, identity and immutable configuration before an unrelated I/O domain is enabled.
Applicability: Potential applications include SRAM repair before fabric activation, security policy before I/O enable, staged multi-die bring-up and power-gated resume.
Limitation: The public evidence provides no quantified boot-time, power, area, BOM or power-integrity improvement. Remaining level shifters, isolation, leakage and sequencing are project-specific.
OpenQuestion: Which read consumers, power states and measurable integration structures are removed or simplified in the target SoC?
Audience: AI System Architects;Low-Power Teams;Product Security;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Translates a macro read-supply feature into measurable AI-SoC integration hypotheses without claiming automatic system improvement.
TitleZH: Core-supply 直接讀取可能簡化 AI SoC 的早期狀態可用性
SecurityClaimZH: 若 exact macro 與 power intent 允許，core-domain OTP read 可能在無關 I/O domain 啟用前提供 repair map、lifecycle policy、identity 與 immutable configuration。
ApplicabilityZH: 可能應用包括 fabric 啟動前的 SRAM repair、I/O 啟用前的 security policy、multi-die 分階段啟動與 power-gated resume。
LimitationZH: 公開證據沒有量化 boot-time、power、area、BOM 或 power-integrity 改善；剩餘 level shifter、isolation、leakage 與 sequencing 都是專案特定。
OpenQuestionZH: 目標 SoC 中哪些 read consumer、power state 與可量測 integration structure 能被移除或簡化？
OIPRelevanceZH: 把 macro read-supply feature 轉換成可量測的 AI SoC 整合假設，但不宣稱系統改善會自動成立。
EvidenceBoundary: Every benefit is conditional on the actual macro interface, wrapper, UPF, power sequence and consumer placement.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 每一項效益都取決於實際 macro interface、wrapper、UPF、power sequence 與 consumer placement。

Title: Market exclusivity and newer-node feature inheritance remain unverified
SecurityClaim: Public evidence verifies a Synopsys 40nm 2.5V-device-class MTP and representative 3.3V or 5V competing offerings, but it does not establish market-wide exclusivity or feature inheritance at every newer node.
Applicability: Governs competitive positioning, roadmap claims and SharePoint Copilot answers about MTP voltage classes and advanced-node read behavior.
Limitation: Custom macros, undisclosed programs, non-floating-gate rewritable NVM and newly released products may provide counterexamples.
OpenQuestion: Can an internally maintained, dated vendor matrix validate the owner-provided assessment that Synopsys is the only current 2.5V floating-gate MTP supplier?
Audience: Technology Strategy;Product Marketing;NVM IP Teams;SharePoint Copilot
OIPRelevance: Prevents a useful commercial hypothesis from becoming an unsupported public exclusivity claim.
TitleZH: 市場唯一性與更先進節點功能繼承仍待驗證
SecurityClaimZH: 公開證據可確認 Synopsys 40nm 2.5V device-class MTP 與代表性 3.3V 或 5V 競品，但不能建立全市場唯一性，或證明更先進節點全部繼承相同行為。
ApplicabilityZH: 治理 MTP voltage class、先進節點 read behavior 的競爭定位、roadmap 主張與 SharePoint Copilot 回答。
LimitationZH: Custom macro、未公開 program、非 floating-gate rewritable NVM 與新發布產品都可能構成反例。
OpenQuestionZH: 能否以公司內部維護且附日期的 vendor matrix，驗證內容擁有者提出的 Synopsys 是目前唯一 2.5V floating-gate MTP 供應商之評估？
OIPRelevanceZH: 避免有價值的商業假設變成缺乏支持的公開排他性主張。
SourceLocator: Validation gate AI-NVM-ADV-007 and owner-provided market assessment
EvidenceBoundary: Publish verified examples and the validation gap; retain complete competitive intelligence and commercial availability in the internal SharePoint layer.
EvidenceBoundaryZH: 公開層發布已驗證案例與驗證缺口；完整競爭情報與商業供應狀態保留於公司 SharePoint 內部層。
